title: Zesty Umami Middle Eastern Pistachio Falafel
description: A rich and creamy falafel recipe featuring unsalted pistachios, ideal for a sick day. This satvik-friendly dish is a twist on traditional Middle Eastern flavors.
instructions: In a food processor, combine chickpeas, unsalted pistachios, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and spices. Process until a coarse paste forms.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and fold in the chopped parsley.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each falafel.
Bake for 18-20 minutes, flipping the falafels halfway through.
While the falafels are baking, prepare the tahini sauce by whisking together tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and 1/4 cup of water in a small bowl.
To assemble the falafels, place a few falafels on a plate, followed by a dollop of the tahini sauce, and garnish with chopped parsley.
